description: Ministry Of Power and Energy - Revise the Fuel Price to be Effective  From 12.00 Midnight on April 30th 2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the revision of fuel prices under the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961. It constitutes a regulatory action where the Minister exercises statutory powers to modify pricing regulations. While it names a specific minister (Kanchana Wijesekera), the primary content is regulatory in nature - establishing new legal requirements for fuel pricing rather than focusing on government personnel or structural changes. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves the implementation and modification of existing legislation through ministerial authority.
